title: Analysis of HMF and furfural in hydrolyzed lignocellulosic biomass by HPLC-DAD-based method using FDCA as internal standard
author: Godoy, Valderrama, et al.

steps.title: Prepare citrate buffer (0.01 M)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 11.7 g trisodium citrate in 4000 mL ultrapure water, then adjust the pH to 2.5 with approximately 600 mL glacial acetic acid, checking with a pH meter.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 11.7 g trisodium citrate in 4000 mL ultrapure water
Adjust pH to 2.5 with ~600 mL glacial acetic acid, verify with pH meter

steps.title: Prepare HMF stock (1.25 mM)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.0158 g HMF analytical standard in 100 mL ultrapure water to obtain a 1.25 mmol L⁻¹ solution.

steps.title: Prepare furfural stock (0.25 mM)
steps.instruction: Dilute 16.6 μL furfural analytical standard into 100 mL ultrapure water to obtain a 2.50 × 10⁻¹ mmol L⁻¹ solution.

steps.title: Prepare FDCA internal standard (0.20 mM)
steps.instruction: First make a 1.20 mmol L⁻¹ FDCA solution by dissolving 0.0188 g analytical standard in 100 mL ultrapure water; then transfer 16.70 mL of this solution into 100 mL ultrapure water to obtain a 2.00 × 10⁻¹ mmol L⁻¹ stock.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1.20 mmol L⁻¹ FDCA solution: dissolve 0.0188 g in 100 mL ultrapure water
Dilute 16.70 mL of the 1.20 mmol L⁻¹ solution into 100 mL ultrapure water

steps.title: Prepare sample for HPLC analysis
steps.instruction: Add 10 μL synthesis sample to 890 μL ultrapure water and 100 μL FDCA internal standard (0.20 mmol L⁻¹), vortex 10 s, filter through a 0.22 μm PTFE hydrophilic syringe filter (Analítica), and store at –20 °C until HPLC injection. For each of the three synthesis replicates, prepare three aqueous‑phase and three organic‑phase replicates for injection.
